commands.name: m119_fresh_corpus_outcome_boundary_gates

decision_rule: Admit a wrong-history outcome surface only if the M118 source-diverse corpus produces continuation or boundary degradation across enough physical source pairs.
failure_criteria: M118 action-level diversity does not translate into outcome-level degradation
boundary-tightened rows collapse again to fewer than 6 physical source pairs
M62 control becomes admitted as a wrong-history surface
hypothesis: M118 found a source-diverse matched-current corpus with preserved action-level wrong-history sensitivity. Repeating outcome and boundary gates may produce a robust wrong-history training surface.
success_criteria: M113-style outcomes are evaluated on the M118 corpus
wrong-history degradation is measured before and after boundary tightening
accepted outcome rows cover enough physical source pairs to pass M116-style robustness
the result decides whether to train a boundary-aware wrong-history objective
